headline: Brazil INSS Updates Sick Leave Rules Without In-Person Examination
summary: Brazil's social security agency INSS updated rules allowing insured individuals whose benefits are denied via document analysis to request reevaluation within ten days, with repeat denials sent for in-person exams.
why: Social security benefit administration changes impact public expenditure outflows and administrative workloads for labor and social welfare agencies.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Streamlining benefit reviews alters social security processing efficiency.
